title: 국가를 당사자로 하는 소송의 수행자에 대한 포상금 지급 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 국가를 당사자로 하는 소송의 수행자에 대한 포상금 지급 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Persons Eligible for Monetary Rewards)
(1) Monetary rewards under these Rules shall be paid to persons who have been designated by the Minister of Justice or the head of an administrative agency to conduct litigation under Article 3 (1) or (2), Article 5 (1), or Article 6 (2) of the Act on Litigation to Which the State Is a Party, and who are identified as litigation performers in the written judgment falling under any of the following subparagraphs; provided, monetary rewards shall not be paid to public officials who conducted litigation jointly with an attorney acting as a litigation representative:
1. Where the State is the plaintiff: A judgment granting all or part of the plaintiff's claims;
2. Where the State or an administrative agency is the defendant: A judgment dismissing all or part of the plaintiff's claims.
(2) In addition to litigation performers who receive monetary rewards under paragraph (1), monetary rewards may be paid separately to public officials who have made outstanding contributions to administrative affairs related to the conduct of that litigation.
